title: Event collateral
slide_intent: Teach designers to adjust emphasis for objects seen at different distances. A tall banner, badge and tabletop item each give the reader a different encounter.
strategic_value: A common palette and graphic language can connect the event venue, its staff and the materials people carry away.
demonstration: Three standing banners fill the left group. At right, colored panels show a mat and cup, a lanyard badge and a laptop with a video-call background.
practical_value: Choose a large message for a banner, a compact identifier for a badge, and check whether the identifying detail survives at actual size.

content_islands.name: Banner group
content_islands.spec: Place three upright displays at different depths on green, showing cyan type-led and pink image-led options.

content_islands.name: Small items
content_islands.spec: Place the cup, mat and badge in colored fields at right. Leave the surrounding objects visible to establish scale.

content_islands.name: Screen application
content_islands.spec: Show the laptop and its background as an event touchpoint distinct from the printed pieces.
